intent: Edge panel for secondary tasks that need more room than a Modal.

requirements: Title is the accessible name, description is aria-describedby when present

doNot: Do not invent Sheet, SidePanel, or local Drawer
Do not add snap points or swipe
Do not skip the close control unless showClose is false AND footer/body still provide a way out. Overlay click and Escape still close.
snippet: <Drawer open={open} title="Edit profile" description="Make changes to your profile." side="right" onClose={close} footer={<ButtonGroup ariaLabel="Drawer actions"><Button variant="secondary" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></ButtonGroup>}>...</Drawer>
